column1: # THE MEASURED IDENTITY AND ITS NCBI TAXID COUNTERPART  (2026-08-10)
# The measured identity text is not always a scientific name that can be searched
# at NCBI: the spelling can differ from NCBI's, or the identity is an unnamed
# lineage whose place only the database's lineage chain shows. This table closes
# that gap ON THE RECORD, so that NO guess is buried inside the audit script.
# The key: either a bin name (B-2_1197717) or the measured identity text.

column3: The name at NCBI is "Candidatus Nitrosocosmicus" (1826864); the measured text writes "Nitrocosmicus" instead of "Nitrosocosmicus" and abbreviates the species epithet to "oleophi". The same genus.

The measured identity is "Bacterium enrichment", an unnamed lineage. Its place is read from the database lineage chain: SILVA SSU NR99 AM933660 Bacteria;Synergistota;Synergistia;Synergistales;Synergistaceae (98.74%) and PR2 SSU AF280863 Synergistales (96.12%). The family: Synergistaceae 649777.
